newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end mixed on late profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end mixed on late profit-taking.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended mixed on Tuesday on late profit-taking as generally soft regional markets dampened market sentiment, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index fell 0.20 points, or 0.03 percent, to close at 705.08 points after touching a day high of 707.85 points. Advancers led decliners by 84 to 58 with 61 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 527 billion rupiah against some 628 billion rupiah on Monday.
